name: Hypercube UI
how_to_use: Import src/index.css (and src/elements.js for <hc-ask> and <hc-sheet>). Copy the markup of each piece; change only the text. Icons: Lucide, stroke 1.8. Full rules in AGENTS.md.

pieces.name: Surfaces and text
pieces.use: Dark is redefined, not inverted. Switch the theme at the top to see both.

pieces.use: The lime (--accent) is always a fill under black text. Accent text and lines use --accent-ink.

pieces.name: Space and radius
pieces.use: A 4 px scale. Panels use --r-lg, controls --r-sm.

pieces.name: Icons
pieces.use: 16 px in general, 13 to 14 px inside small buttons. The library does not depend on them: use your own, with the same stroke.

pieces.name: Kinds
pieces.use: Primary is a black pill (lime in dark). Danger only for what deletes.

pieces.use: One choice among up to four options that always show: the way to view (list, board) or a short filter (All, Unread). A filter people build and remove is a .chip.

pieces.name: Context switcher
pieces.use: The workspace, organisation or product the person works in, the same way in every app. One per app, the first row of the menu (.side-top), in place of .hc-brand: the logo and name of the current one and the up-down chevrons. It opens a menu with every choice (logo, name, plan or role on the right), the current one checked, then what acts on them: settings, create, invite, only the ones that work. Choosing reloads the whole app in the new context. Never a select field, never in the top bar or inside a page.

pieces.name: Loading indicator
pieces.use: The one and only house loader, the same as Datacube's: a hexagon with a stroke running round the outline. Colour comes from the text. 14 px in lists and buttons, 24 px for a page. Always this one, never another.

pieces.name: Usage timeline
pieces.use: One row per run on a 24-hour track (--from and --len are fractions of it; --now draws the now line). The app draws the chart above and moves the bars; data-over hatches the part that lands over the limit.
